en.about_change_first_description: Replace the placeholder product name, identifiers, icons, and page content before publishing a real application. Keep signing credentials outside the repository.
en.about_included_description: Vite builds the web app, Electron packages desktop builds, Capacitor connects the web output to native mobile projects, and Playwright checks the browser shell.
en.about_intro: BigfootDS ReactJS Multiplatform Template is a starting point for browser, desktop, and mobile applications that share one React user interface.
en.diagnostics_app_shell_detail: The same routed React layout is shared by web, Electron, and Capacitor builds.
en.diagnostics_intro: Check the capabilities that affect persistence and platform adapters before initialising them. This route only performs feature detection: it does not open a database, request storage, or invoke native code.
en.home_browser_first_description: Build normal React screens in src/ and keep platform code at the edges.
en.home_desktop_ready_description: Electron packages the same web application for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
en.home_heading: Start with a real app shell
en.home_intro: This template now includes a small, browser-safe structure for a web, desktop, or mobile product. Use these pages as a place to grow the app, not as product copy to keep forever.
en.home_mobile_ready_description: Capacitor synchronises the web build into native mobile projects.
en.not_found_intro: The address does not match a route in this application.
en.settings_intro: Preferences are stored as one versioned settings entity. The selected backend is {{backend}}, while React components remain independent of SQLocal, Kysely, and IndexedDB.
en.settings_theme_description: Theme colours use plain CSS variables. Full screen goes through the Electron IPC wrapper or browser Fullscreen API.
en.settings_translation_description: Available languages come from the generated localisation manifest and are persisted with the settings entity.
